title: Multi-Column Selection
seoDescription: Create a pandas DataFrame and select an ordered subset of named columns without changing row order.
description:
Select an ordered list of multiple columns from a pandas DataFrame while preserving row ordering.

$$
\text{sub\_df} = \text{df}[[c_1, c_2, \dots, c_k]]
$$

Given input parameters `records`, `selected_columns`, return list of records containing only the designated columns.
